title: Port the 22 CLI and harness parity gaps to the Rust step definitions
description: First batch of the Rust gaps in tools/parity/known_unimplemented_steps.txt: the gitignore, project-local, guard-file, environment-variable, daemon-error, created-issue-id and standup-parity steps (22 lines). Implement each in rust/features/steps mirroring the Python step's behaviour, make the owning scenarios pass under cargo test, and remove the lines from the ratchet. Acceptance: tools/check_spec_parity.py passes with the ratchet reduced by these 22 lines, cargo test passes, cargo fmt and clippy clean. The console-server issue-write API, routing assignment and console now steps are a later batch.
